description: Lower background noise (fans, traffic, hum) in a recording with DeepFilterNet; returns MP3. The first five minutes are cleaned.

file.description: The file, base64-encoded (a data: URL also works). Up to 5 MB.

limit.description: The most noise is lowered by, in decibels, 6 to 100. Lower sounds more natural. Default 100.

name: remove_audio_noise
title: Remove audio noise
